mysteryClues.text: Warm air lasts through much of the year, and a rainy season brings sudden tropical showers.

An old temple in Asakusa is reached through a lively street of stalls and lanterns.

mysteryClues.text: This large city sits where green riverbanks meet the dry edge of a broad desert.

Green river islands and leafy banks make open spaces beside dense city streets.
A historic covered market has narrow lanes filled with shops, cafés, and crafts.
Nearby, ancient stone pyramids rise from the desert beside the Great Sphinx.
This city is the capital of Egypt.
